content: Melvin-Koushki cites Ibn Turka's censure of Zamakhsharī in the opening section of part four of the Mafāḥiṣ (MS Majlis 10196 f.90a) as showing that his dislike of Muʿtazili views is expressed in his own doctrinal work too.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, Mafāḥiṣ, MS Majlis 10196 f.90a (per MK fn.122)
